verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the source-control docs page, whose URL is 'use-source-control-and-environments' and which covers pushing and pulling changes. Together with Git version control listed on the pricing page and self-hosting on your own infrastructure, this implies separate dev and production instances can be kept in sync. Nothing explicitly describes a sandbox or a way to isolate test runs from production data, so support is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit sandbox or test-environment feature, documentation that test executions are isolated from production data and credentials, details of how environments are configured, and hands-on corroboration.
